accuracy_m.description: Rough error of the walls, e.g. 0.01 prebuilt, 0.15 from a photo

floor_seen.description: Rooms from photos: the part of the floor the photos showed, as a polygon. Absent = all of it is known; the rest is a guess (drawn grey)

glb.description: URL of the room shell model, or null to draw it from walls

walls.description: Inner faces, in order around the room (counter-clockwise from above)

seen.description: Rooms from photos: the spans of this wall the photos showed, as [from, to] metres from a. Absent = all of it is known; [] = none of it was seen (drawn grey, a guess)

from.description: Distance along the wall from a to the opening's near edge

swing.description: Doors that swing into this room

hinge.description: Which end of the opening (towards wall end a or b)

fixtures.description: Things that never move: radiators, built-in cupboards, columns

furniture.description: Movable pieces already in the room

style.description: Filled by the room analysis: tags and main colours

category.description: sofa, armchair, table, chair, desk, bed, rug, shelf, lamp, plant, radiator, cupboard, tv, other

size.description: [width, depth, height] in the piece's own frame

on_floor.description: false for things on a table or wall (they don't block paths)

piece.description: Optional piece id (piece.schema.json) it was made from

color.description: Optional main colour #rrggbb (photo rooms read it from the photo; absent = the app picks)
